# The call vocabulary of the WhatsApp APK. A name outside this file is not in the
# protocol, and an app that writes it is guessing at the wire.
#
# Section 1 is the WABinary dictionary, copied verbatim from
#   .tools/apk/src-full/sources/X/AbstractC40951ro.java (arrays A00 and A01).
# Section 2 is the names the offer deserializer registers, from the string pool of
#   call_control::stanza_deserializer::stanzas::offer in libwhatsappmerged.so
#   (x 14,410,496 in .tools/apk/native/armeabi-v7a-libs.so).
# Section 3 is names the native code and the WP8 client use and the dictionary does
#   not carry (they travel spelled out): batterystate (VoipSignaling.WriteVoipNode),
#   fingerprint and relay_name (libwhatsappmerged strings).
# --- section 1: the WABinary dictionary ---
